sentences.en: The fabulous Sara Ramirez portrayed Callie's struggle with her sexuality with great poise while the ever talented Chandra Wilson played Bailey's vulnerability as she rediscovered her career and a new life without her husband.

sentences.en: George and Meredith have a one-night affair, and he later begins a relationship with Callie (Sara Ramirez).
